aboutText: Bioglow was born from a friendship, shaped by years of experience in luxury spas and wellness spaces across the world. What started between treatments, sea breezes, and quiet cups of coffee became a shared vision: to create a space where women can feel completely supported — not just treated, but truly seen. We combine the precision of science with the warmth of care. Each treatment is intentionally crafted to work in harmony with your body’s natural rhythm, using proven techniques and top-tier products. But beyond the ingredients and methods, what sets us apart is the atmosphere — calm, one-on-one, and devoted entirely to you. This is not just skincare. It’s a return to yourself. If that resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our space in the heart of Niš. We work by appointment only, and reservations are kindly requested at least one week in advance.
aboutUsText: Bioglow was created from years of experience in some of the world’s finest hotels and spas — and a shared mission to bring that five-star care into a space made just for you We believe beauty begins within. That slowing down is powerful. And that skincare is not just a routine, but a ritual of balance, health, and self-respect. At Bioglow, every detail is designed to help you reconnect — with your body, your rhythm, and your inner glow.

signatureSkin.title: Signature skin
signatureSkin.descr: Powered by the Original Dr. Schrammek Professional System. Each facial begins with a professional skin assessment and thoughtful consultation. We work exclusively with original German Dr. Schrammek formulations, designed to restore balance, strengthen the skin barrier, and support long-term skin health.

bioglow.title: BIOGLOW Signature Skin Ritual —
bioglow.subtitle: 60 min / 6500 RSD
bioglow.text: Our most balanced and most requested facial. A personalized treatment designed according to your skin's current condition and long-term needs. Includes precise cleansing, refined exfoliation, targeted mask therapy, relaxing facial massage, and protective finishing care. Manual purification may be incorporated when necessary. Structured for visible results. Designed for lasting balance.

bioglowExtended.title: BIOGLOW Signature Skin Ritual Extended —
bioglowExtended.subtitle: 90 min / 10,000 RSD
bioglowExtended.text: An immersive renewal experience featuring advanced peeling protocols (including the Triple Effect approach), manual lifting techniques, and extended relaxation time. Corrective yet deeply calming. For skin transformation and nervous system reset.

cleanseGo.title: BIOGLOW Cleanse & Go —
cleanseGo.subtitle: 40 min / 4,200 RSD
cleanseGo.text: A focused professional refresh treatment ideal between intensive protocols or before important occasions. Includes cleansing, gentle exfoliation, targeted mask therapy, and protective finishing care. Deep pore purification (manual extraction) is not included in this treatment. When deeper cleansing is required, it can be added as Precision Skin Refinement, performed with meticulous extraction techniques and followed by Darsonval high-frequency therapy to calm the skin and support circulation. Efficient. Intentional. Restorative.

renewalRitual.title: BIOGLOW Signature Renewal Ritual —
renewalRitual.subtitle: 150 min / 12,500 RSD
renewalRitual.text: Our most complete face & body experience. A carefully sequenced ritual combining therapeutic body massage, reflexology, scalp care, and a mini facial. This is not simply a treatment. It is a full return to yourself.

precisionRefinement.title: Precision Skin Refinement —
precisionRefinement.subtitle: 1,500 RSD
precisionRefinement.text: Manual comedone extraction performed with precision and care when additional deep cleansing is required. Finished with Darsonval high-frequency therapy to calm the skin, stimulate circulation, and support recovery.

bodyContour.title: Body Treatments & Silhouette Sculpting
bodyContour.descr:
No parallel treatments. No rush. No exposure.

Each ritual takes place in a private, female-only space, offering you absolute dedication, privacy, and peace.

bodySculpt.title: BIOGLOW Body Sculpt Ritual —
bodySculpt.subtitle: 90 min / 7,900 RSD
bodySculpt.text: A comprehensive, synergistic body ritual designed as an intensive support system to reduce the volume of localized areas, promote natural drainage, and improve skin tone. This advanced protocol seamlessly combines technology and high-end manual techniques through carefully structured phases:

list.0: Dry body brushing to stimulate surface microcirculation and restore skin radiance.
list.1: Manual preparation of drainage pathways to support the natural release of excess fluid.
list.2: Ultrasonic cavitation for targeted action on stubborn, localized areas.
list.3: Tone activation and drainage powered by Ultra Contour Touch technology.
list.4: Gua Sha technique to release muscle and fascia tension while boosting deep circulation.
list.5: Gliding vacuum cups for drainage and smoothing the skin’s texture.
list.6: A soothing closing massage for a feeling of deep relaxation and lightness.

bodySculpt.afterText: The technology combines muscle stimulation and drainage activation designed to support tissue metabolism, circulation, and skin firmness. Technology supports the process. The ritual leads it.

targetedContour.title: Targeted Contour Session —
targetedContour.subtitle: 30–40 min / 4,200 RSD
targetedContour.text: A focused, intensive treatment dedicated to a specific region of the body—ideal for areas such as the abdomen, thighs, or hips. It is based on Ultra Contour Touch technology, which uses electromuscle stimulation (EMS) to activate muscle tone, accelerate local tissue metabolism, encourage the release of retained fluid, and improve skin firmness. A perfect choice as a maintenance treatment between full rituals.

programs.sectionSubtext: An investment in consistency and support for the natural physiology of the tissue.

silhouette.title: BIOGLOW Silhouette Program —
silhouette.subtitle: 6 treatments + Premium Gratis / 30,900 RSD
silhouette.text: A comprehensive, month-long program designed as a deep support system for the body to release retained fluid, soften the appearance of cellulite, and restore firmness. This program strategically pairs the lipolytic action of cavitation with intensive, fluid drainage, respecting the body's natural rhythm and metabolic capacity.

list.0: 3× BIOGLOW Body Sculpt Ritual (90 min) — performed once every 10 days, allowing optimal time for the body to naturally integrate the effects of the treatment.
list.1: 3× Targeted Contour Session (40 min) — focused drainage and muscle tone activation between major rituals, for a light and unburdened feeling.
list.2: COMPLIMENTARY FINALE: The exclusive BIOGLOW Signature Renewal Ritual (150 min) — a premium two-and-a-half-hour face and body ritual that restores the skin barrier and provides profound relaxation (regular price: 12,500 RSD).
list.3: ESSENTIAL SUPPORT: A simplified BIOGLOW nutrition and optimal hydration guide which, alongside your active lifestyle, ensures the proper transport of released fats and supports the body’s natural cleansing processes.

silhouette.afterText: Payment option available in two equal installments (at the 1st and 3rd session).

sculptLift.text: An intensive, focused program designed for clients seeking more frequent muscle tone activation, skin tightening, and rapid relief from heaviness and bloating in a specific region (e.g., abdomen, glutes, or thighs only).

talking.title: Virtuelne konsultacije i lični vodič kroz sastojke / 3,000 RSD
talking.text: True skincare begins the moment we stop experimenting with random products and start listening to the unique needs of our skin. To help you understand your face's specific reactions and build a conscious, highly effective routine, we have designed a virtual consultation format led by Tijana, our resident biologist.

list.0: The Initial Insight: Prior to our session, a thoughtfully curated questionnaire allows you to share the details of your lifestyle, current habits, and the products you choose.
list.1: 1-on-1 Session: During your private virtual conversation, Tijana analyzes your skin’s behavior to identify the true underlying causes of concerns such as dehydration, sensitivity, or sebum imbalance.
list.2: Your Written Guide: Following the consultation, you will receive a comprehensive, personalized report — your skin profile, complete with clear guidelines on which ingredients to introduce, which to avoid, and how to properly layer your care for long-term results.

talking.afterText: The Synergy of Science and Decades of Expertise We believe that refined skincare demands absolute honesty and depth. Tijana views the skin through the lens of pure biology and ingredient formulation. To perfectly bridge scientific theory with practical application, every questionnaire and final guide undergoes a collaborative review, integrating the expert insight of our aesthetician, who brings over a decade of experience in luxury spa operations and direct skin cultivation. Out of deep respect for the boundaries of our profession, it is essential to note that our consultations are strictly educational and dedicated to cosmetic care. Should you be experiencing medical, dermatological conditions or skin diseases, we will always, with the utmost care and responsibility, advise you to seek the guidance of a medical dermatologist.

fallAnnouncement.title: Autumn Announcement - Coming this September to BIOGLOW studio.
fallAnnouncement.descr: Long-lasting Smoothness: A New Era of Skin Gentleness
fallAnnouncement.text: With the first days of autumn, our space will be enhanced with sophisticated light technology for permanent hair removal. Guided by our Slow Beauty philosophy, we have chosen a system that delivers top-tier efficiency without compromising the health and comfort of your skin.

list.0: Absolute Comfort: The treatment is designed to be completely painless, free of irritation or harsh sensations, ensuring a pleasant and relaxing experience.
list.1: Safety First: The technology works gradually and selectively, protecting the surrounding tissue and making the treatment safe for all skin types.
list.2: Expertise and Peace: Each treatment is performed by a professional aesthetician, with utmost dedication in an environment that guarantees your total privacy.

fallAnnouncement.afterText: Priority Bookings: To maintain our standard of uncompromised attention to every detail, spaces for our autumn packages at introductory rates will be limited. If you wish to secure your place in time, you may join our interest list during your next visit to Bioglow or via our contact form.

notes.0: *Professional Note: BIOGLOW Signature rituals (60, 90, and 150 min) are exclusively performed by the founder of the brand and a graduate aesthetician-cosmetician.
notes.1: *Results Note: Our technology and protocols are designed to physiologically support, accelerate, and ease the process of drainage, muscle toning, and skin structure improvement. For optimal and long-lasting results, treatments must be paired with adequate water intake, a balanced diet, and regular physical activity.
notes.2: *Due to the intensive mechanical and technological action of cavitation and electro-stimulation, body programs carry certain contraindications (pregnancy, breastfeeding, pacemakers, metal implants in the targeted area, compromised liver or kidney function). Prior to starting any program, we will conduct a detailed, complimentary consultation.
